causal_mechanism: Two forces compete. Concentration: each entry-layer neuron function is exactly zonal about its own normalized weight row, so the entry layer's degree-six energy sits in a subspace of dimension at most the width rather than in the ambient degree-six space; the linear-response channel of every deeper rectifier (its first Hermite coefficient acting on an approximately Gaussian preactivation) carries that exactly-zonal content forward unchanged through every subsequent layer, and the replicated deep-pullback collinearity says deep composition further collapses preferred directions toward a small number of dominant input-space axes, which the active-subspace eigenvectors of the tangential input gradient expose directly. Dispersion: the higher Hermite channels of each rectifier form products of zonal functions about DIFFERENT axes, and such products leave every single-axis zonal span; degree six is cheap to build out of products of degrees one, two and three, which carry far more energy than the entry layer's own degree-six coefficient, so with depth the non-zonal channel can dominate. The measurement decides the balance. With the addition-theorem normalization the zonal function about an axis, scaled by the square root of the degree-six dimension, has unit norm and inner product equal to the normalized Gegenbauer polynomial of the axis-axis cosine, so captured degree-six energy is directly comparable across axis sets of equal count. Captured energy is estimated by a split-half cross product of Monte-Carlo coefficients, which is exactly unbiased and can go negative under the null, against six matched-count random axis pools measured on the identical samples, which supply the in-run noise floor and its spread.
cheapest_falsifier: Run three seeded synthetic depth-thirty-two width-256 He networks. For each, form the own-axis pool (the normalized first-layer weight rows plus the top eight eigenvectors of the tangential input-gradient second moment, estimated on an independent pilot sample) and six matched-count pools of uniform random axes. On two independent Monte-Carlo halves compute the addition-theorem-normalized degree-six zonal coefficients of the depth-thirty-two readout and form the split-half cross product through each pool's exact Gram matrix. Express every captured energy as a fraction of the same network's degree-three-and-above residual energy (degrees zero and one removed by pilot-fitted exact-zero control variates, their leftover and the degree-two energy subtracted by unbiased split-half estimators). If the own-axis fraction fails to reach four times the larger of the measured random floor and the predeclared materiality bar, the network-adaptive zonal door closes with a measured number and the degree-six accuracy lane is closed on a second, independent axis.
equal_budget_baseline: Six matched-count random axis pools (264 uniform directions each) measured on the IDENTICAL Monte-Carlo samples with the IDENTICAL estimator and the identical exact Gram solve -- the only difference between arms is where the axes come from. Their maximum is the floor, their spread across the eighteen pool-by-seed draws is the in-run Monte-Carlo noise measurement. Two exact positive controls ride the same pipeline: the entry-layer activation and the second-layer preactivation, whose degree-six components are provably inside the own-axis zonal span. A matched isotropic-null active-subspace spectrum, built from the same number of iid Gaussian vectors, is the control for the pullback-concentration claim.
hypothesis: Degree-six error energy in a deep ReLU network is NOT dispersed uniformly over the full degree-six spherical-harmonic space of the input sphere (dimension of order four hundred billion at input dimension two hundred fifty-six); a material share of it lives on the zonal subspace generated by the network's OWN axes. The generator is exact at the entry layer: relu(w_i . u) depends on u only through the cosine with its own normalized weight row, hence is exactly zonal about it, and every second-layer preactivation, being a linear combination of first-layer ridge functions, is exactly contained in the span of those zonal functions. The claim under test is that a material share of that concentration SURVIVES deep composition: at depth thirty-two the network function's degree-six component still projects onto the zonal family built from the network's own first-layer weight rows together with its dominant pullback directions, at a level far above the matched-count random-axis floor AND at a level large enough, as a share of the degree-three-and-above residual energy, that a theorem-fixed-coefficient degree-six control could remove a material part of it. If either leg fails the door closes with a measured number.
inconclusive_band_note: The metric is the LARGER of two requirements divided by the own-axis capture, so it reports whichever leg binds; the runner emits both legs separately (leg_structural_floor_over_own, leg_material_bar_over_own) and the judge MUST copy the leg split into the disposition record, because the ledger's single stored metric cannot say which leg bound (designer's self-attack, accepted). The band (0.25, 0.75) means the own-axis family captures between 1.33 and 4 times the binding requirement -- above the noise but short of a construction warrant; in the band the disposition is an owner call with the measured number and depth ladder attached. The materiality bar 0.02 is calibrated against m191 (fixed 24-function basis, R^2 0.23-0.29 percent, +0.83 percent panel MSE against a 10 percent bar): a fifth of that MSE bar and roughly seven times m191's achieved basis R^2. Because the k32 death law forbids fitted coefficients, captured energy is an UPPER bound on what a lawful control could remove. A PASS authorizes only a separately frozen construction stage, never a control.

The metric lands in the KILL region with probability about 0.90, driven by the MATERIALITY leg alone while the STRUCTURAL leg passes -- that split is the predicted shape and it is the informative outcome. provenance: Executes the 2026-08-18 channel hypothesis (pullback collinearity x S15 zonal ceiling splice) as a measurement; designed by an Opus agent, judged, transcribed and sealed by the judge. PREMISE VS NEIGHBOURING KILLS, so the collision scan can be checked by eye: (1) m191_harmonic_cv_g0b fitted split-sample coefficients for a FIXED 24-function basis from pooled singular vectors and measured regression gain against cached truth; this cell fits NOTHING, uses the network-ADAPTIVE per-neuron zonal basis m191 never formed, and measures projected energy. (2) s15_firstlayer_stratification_premise tested cheap low-dimensional covariates; a degree-six zonal projection is an exactly mean-zero object orthogonal to everything its Base-B removes. (3) gm_p2b_proxy was weights-predict-scalars, killed by rotation invariance; here the weights supply AXES for a function-space projection that is manifestly not rotation invariant. (4) k32_base_sensitivity's death law (theorem-fixed coefficients only) is the reason this cell exists; its PASS branch leads only to a theorem-fixed construction. (5) m107_spherical_gegenbauer_exact_zero_controls, the closest relative: died on HELD coefficient-transport ratios after favorable training ratios -- the k32 law, not absent zonal energy; its training-side ratios are weak evidence FOR this premise. TRANSFER LOGIC AND ITS LIMIT, declared: no truth machinery exists in a dev-only cell, so the measured object is the network function, not the estimator residual; the design integrates degrees zero through two exactly, so the residual inherits the function's degree-six component to first order -- a KILL transfers a fortiori, a PASS would require a follow-on stage with truth. WHY NO ABSOLUTE DEGREE-SIX FRACTION: the projection kernel has variance of order the degree-six dimension (4.14e11), unestimable at this budget; the reported currency (captured over degree-three-and-above residual) is exactly the R^2 a control on those axes could achieve and is directly comparable to m191. BUDGET: about 6.6e12 float64 FLOPs; designer-measured quarter-scale wall 10.66 s extrapolating to ~121 s against the 600 s cap; judge smoke 3.6 s at 1/16 scale, consistent. Zero billed FLOPs against H. Production seeds 20260901-20260903 never executed before the gate. Runner emits the metric under the declared threshold name and reports config.seeds for the harness seed-agreement check; Gegenbauer identities assert at import so numerical regression becomes a protocol kill. Either branch yields the depth-resolved concentration curve and the controlled pullback-concentration measurement as write-up artifacts. second_signal: Three, in-run, each able to fail independently of the metric. (a) ANALYTIC PIPELINE CHECK: for the entry-layer targets the own-axis coefficient has a closed form -- relu(t) = (t + |t|)/2 and the linear part is orthogonal to the degree-six zonal, so the coefficient equals the row norm times the closed-form lambda built from exact absolute moments; the measured pooled ratio must sit near one at production scale. (b) DEPTH LADDER SHAPE: the entry-layer activation and the second-layer preactivation are PROVABLY inside the own-axis zonal span, so both must sit far above their matched floors; a ladder that does not start high and decay is an instrument failure regardless of the readout. (c) FLOOR AND SPREAD: eighteen matched random pool draws give the noise floor, its standard deviation and the resolvable effect at three standard deviations, so the power of the measurement is reported rather than assumed. Plus the pullback active-subspace spectrum against its matched isotropic null -- an independent, properly controlled restatement of the deep-collinearity observation the hypothesis leans on.
